scope: All 1,291 chapter pages under /study-guides/cross-references/ (348,409 cross-reference entries, 66,460 distinct reference labels).
reference_text: Saints-Translation commit 328967336f32958587835c921fea3b96a5bf6494 and the site’s own /wp-json/saints/v1/text output (identical for all 30,870 shared verses).

wrong_reading_mappings.label: Exodus 39:34
wrong_reading_mappings.english_content: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen

correct_saints_reading.text: the leather coverings of rams’ skins dyed red, the coverings of blue skins, and the coverings for the remaining things;

wrong_reading_mappings.explanation: Shown as unavailable, but Greek 39:20 lists the coverings.

wrong_reading_mappings.label: Exodus 39:36
wrong_reading_mappings.english_content: the table, all its vessels, the show bread

currently_shown.text: the altar and all its utensils, the anointing oil, and the compounded incense;

correct_saints_reading.text: the table of presentation and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

wrong_reading_mappings.explanation: Shown as Greek 39:15 (the altar); the table is Greek 39:17.

wrong_reading_mappings.label: Exodus 39:38
wrong_reading_mappings.english_content: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen

currently_shown.text: the table of presentation and all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

correct_saints_reading.text: the altar and all its utensils, the anointing oil, and the compounded incense;

wrong_reading_mappings.explanation: Shown as Greek 39:17 (the table); altar, anointing oil and incense are Greek 39:15.

wrong_reading_mappings.label: Exodus 39:39
wrong_reading_mappings.english_content: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels

currently_shown.text: Aaron’s robes for the sanctuary and his sons’ robes for priestly service;

correct_saints_reading.text: the altar and all its utensils, the anointing oil, and the compounded incense;

wrong_reading_mappings.explanation: Shown as Greek 39:18 (Aaron’s robes); the Greek list has a single altar entry, 39:15.

wrong_reading_mappings.label: Exodus 39:41
wrong_reading_mappings.english_content: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron

currently_shown.text: the pegs, and all the equipment for the work of the Tent of Testimony.

correct_saints_reading.text: Aaron’s robes for the sanctuary and his sons’ robes for priestly service;

wrong_reading_mappings.explanation: Shown as Greek 39:21 (the pegs); Aaron’s robes are Greek 39:18.

wrong_reading_mappings.label: Joshua 19:47
wrong_reading_mappings.english_content: Dan’s border went beyond them; Dan fought against Leshem, took it and called it Dan

currently_shown.text: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the sons of Dan according to their divisions—their cities and their villages.

correct_saints_reading.text: The sons of Dan did not drive out the Amorites who were pressing them in the hill country. The Amorites did not allow them to descend into the valley and pressed away from them the boundary of their allotted portion.
The sons of Judah went and fought against Lachish, captured it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and inhabited it. They called its name Lasendak.

wrong_reading_mappings.explanation: Shown as Greek 19:47, which is the inheritance formula (English 19:48). Dan’s pressure and the Leshem/Lasendak capture are Greek 19:47a–48.

readings_wrongly_marked_unavailable.cause: Proverbs 24:23–34, 30:15–33 and 31:10–31 are published on separate Greek-order pages (chapter-24-source-block-2, chapter-30-source-block-2, chapter-31-source-block-2). The reference resolver only searches the main chapter page, so these verses are reported as missing from the edition.

source_verses_without_cross_reference_se.cause: Same resolver gap: the Proverbs 24, 30 and 31 cross-reference pages stop at 24:22e, 30:14 and 31:9.
